1.why: A clean sans-serif face is used at a comfortable size with reasonably open line spacing and tall input boxes, though letter-spacing is default rather than notably generous.

2.why: Every screen uses sentence case, no italics or all-caps, and text is limited to one short heading plus one short sentence.

3.why: The content sits in a single narrow centred column that would likely reflow acceptably, but no mobile-width rendering is shown and the wide desktop framing plus a 'Logs' developer panel is the only evidence available.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code delivered to your verified mobile number.' are one short sentence in plain language.

5.why: No placeholder, hint or sample value is shown for any field; the only format cue is the words 'six-digit code', with no worked example.

6.why: No screen contains more than a heading and a single short sentence, so no long text must be read to continue.

7.why: No secret, seed key or recovery code is ever displayed and there are no copy buttons anywhere in the captured flow.

8.why: No QR code or scan-based alternative appears; the flow never reaches authenticator enrolment and only offers a manual code field.

9.why: Fields have proper visible labels but there is no observable autofill/autocomplete support (e.g. one-time-code hinting or password-manager affordance) in the screenshots.

10.why: The section heading and the single solid blue button are visually dominant, but there is no step indicator or progress cue telling the user which stage of the process they are on.

11.why: Each screen requests one primary action via a single button, although the first screen asks for two pieces of information at once.

12.why: Feedback is limited to terse technical entries in a 'Logs' list ('Identity verification delivery was initiated.') and an error line; the system never states plainly what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The user can press 'Verify identity' again after failure, but there is no resend/re-request code option and no reveal/hide control for any secret.

14.why: 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not blame the user but also fails to say what the problem was or how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown timer, expiry warning or session clock appears on any screen, implying no time pressure, though generous validity is never explicitly stated.
